description: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689: a horizontal, risk-based law for AI systems and general-purpose AI models placed on the EU market or whose output is used in the EU.

A safety component of a regulated product (Annex I) or a system used in an Annex III area such as employment, credit, education or biometrics. Carries risk management, logging, oversight, documentation and conformity duties.
The AI Act's transparency duties: disclose AI interaction, mark generated content machine-readably, disclose deepfakes and inform people exposed to emotion recognition.
A general-purpose AI model. Its provider owes documentation, downstream information, a copyright policy and a training-content summary; systemic-risk models owe more.

Regulation (EU) 2026/1744: amended the AI Act's schedule by deferring high-risk obligations (later for Annex III systems, later still for Annex I products), added prohibitions and simplified duties for smaller companies.
Fundamental rights impact assessment, required before use from public bodies and deployers of credit scoring and life or health insurance pricing systems.
